title: The expander mixing lemma and the Alon–Boppana bound
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of two basic results of spectral graph theory, stated through the adjacency quadratic form on vectors orthogonal to the all-ones vector: the expander mixing lemma of Alon and Chung (for a d-regular graph on n ≥ 2 vertices with |x·Ax| ≤ μ‖x‖² on 𝟙⊥, |e(S,T) − d|S||T|/n| ≤ μ√(|S||T|)), and the Alon–Boppana bound in Nilli's form (a d-regular graph, d ≥ 2, with two vertices at distance at least 2k + 4 has a nonzero x ⟂ 𝟙 with x·Ax ≥ (2√(d−1) − (2√(d−1) − 1)/(k+1))‖x‖²). Mathlib has adjacency matrices but neither result.
